cards.t: Bitwise Rolls Out First Spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca
cards.b: Bitwise launched the first spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca, driving strong institutional inflows and crossing $52.8 million in threshold volume by day two.

per.NEAR: Major institutional onramp via ETF launch provides a strong catalyst for spot demand.

cards.t: Binance Futures to Launch USDⓈ-Margined CTUSDT Perpetual Contract
cards.b: Binance Futures announced the launch of the USDⓈ-Margined CTUSDT perpetual contract, bringing increased leverage and liquidity to the token.

per.CT: Futures listings on Binance typically drive heightened volatility and speculative trading volume.

cards.t: CME Group to Launch Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures
cards.b: CME Group is expanding its regulated derivatives offerings by launching Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures contracts.

per.UNI: Regulated futures on CME open the door for more institutional capital allocation.
per.BCH: Institutional product expansion enhances market legitimacy and derivatives liquidity.

cards.t: Grayscale Sets Competitive 0.29% Hyperliquid ETF Fee
cards.b: Grayscale has aggressively undercut competitors by setting a 0.29% fee for its Hyperliquid ETF, positioning the product for wider institutional capture.

per.HYPE: Fee positioning signals imminent product push and potential inflows for the underlying token.
